pages.title: Kaluza-Klein Singularity
pages.text: Kaluza-Klein shards compacted into a single point, their fifth-dimensional momentum crushed together. The point crackles with faint static and spins slowly around an axis that does not seem to exist in three dimensions.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Each Kaluza-Klein shard carries momentum around a hidden dimension. Compressing enough of them in the Singularity Compactor, I folded that dimension into a single charged point.
$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Baryon Asymmetry.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Omniscience Catalyst.
